title: spec(app-shell,plugin-detail,plugin-kanban,cli,plugin-gantt,plugin-map,tests): the small P1 sites that block objectui#8347's index-signature removal, one bundle
body:
Filing-gate category: ① — named landing points: the sites that objectui#8347's premise P1 enumerated, ordered by the objectui#7927 ruling's step 1. A derived child of in-flight objectui#8347, filed with the parent's `domain:spec` and `priority:p2`.
Reader: the `domain:spec @ objectui` seat (objectui#10217) dispatches it after its serial items clear (see Serial below), and an os-dev executes it.
Parent: objectui#8347. That card stays `pm:blocked` until this card and its siblings land.

## Why one card

objectui#8327's sequencing ruling `5587717012` sets one card per reader package. These packages each carry one to four sites, so they ride together. The seat's ACCEPT `5926169140` on objectui#8347 set this unit. Each package's sites are decided independently, by the same per-key rule as objectui#11347, #11348 and #11349.

## The population (measured at `5262f7dd3`; re-derive at `main`)

**Shipped source**

| package · file | key | what tsc says |
|---|---|---|
| app-shell · `environment/EnvironmentListToolbar.tsx` ×2, `views/InterfaceListPage.tsx`, `views/ObjectView.tsx` | `location` | object literal typed `BaseSchema` |
| plugin-detail · `DetailView.tsx` ×2 | `showHeader` | read off `DetailViewSchema` |
| plugin-kanban · `ObjectKanban.tsx` | `swimlaneField` | read off `ObjectKanbanSchema` |
| cli · `commands/validate.ts` ×2 | `title` | read across the zod-inferred node union |
| plugin-gantt · `ObjectGantt.tsx` | (none) | TS2352: `ObjectGanttSchema` converted to `Record<string, unknown>` |
| plugin-map · `ObjectMap.tsx` | (none) | TS2352: `MapConfigSource` converted to `Record<string, unknown>` |

**Tests, the non-probe errors only**

| package | where | what |
|---|---|---|
| app-shell | `useOfferedNavRunAction`, `countLabels.ruAr-10242` | `location`, `items` |
| plugin-detail | four `DetailView.*` tests | `showHeader` ×2, `text`, and a `Record` → `DetailViewSchema` conversion |
| plugin-charts | three `ObjectChart.*` tests | `isAnimationActive` ×5 on `ObjectChartSchema` |
| plugin-charts | `ObjectChartBlock.props-8885` | `objectName`, `dataSource` on a `BaseSchema` literal |
| plugin-map | `ObjectMap.propertiesBag-10859` | a `Record` → `BaseSchema` conversion |
| plugin-grid | `dataTableSchemaSlot-6459` | a type assertion that reads `false` once the signature goes |

The type assertion in plugin-grid may be a ceiling pin. If so, it is objectui#8347's flip: measure it and say which.

The probe keys (`xAxisKy`, `objectNme`, `bogusKeyRefusedNowhere`, `visibleWhn`, `enableClusterng`, `objectNaem`) are ceiling pins. They are NOT this card's: they flip in objectui#8347's removal commit.

**Resolved elsewhere, so re-check only:** plugin-tree's `tree` read and the `navigation` test read. PR objectui#11335 (objectui#11168 slice 3) declares both on `ObjectTreeSchema` by reference to the 17.5.0 row. After it lands, re-derive and confirm 0.

**Re-derive it:** apply objectui#8347's P1 mutation in a worktree, rebuild `@object-ui/types`, and run each package's type-check programs un-chained. Capture the exit codes before any pipe.

## What each site owes (measure, ⛔ none is decided here)

The objectui#8648–#8655 family's rule, with 协议为基准:
- **Spec declares the key:** declare it by reference.
- **Spec does not declare it, and a real producer authors it:** a fork, reported with the four-axis frame.
- **Nothing authors it:** retire the read or the literal.
- **Host-supplied:** a typed prop or channel, ⛔ not a declaration.
- **The TS2352 conversions:** type the accessor, or convert through `unknown` with a comment saying why.

## Serial

- **plugin-map `ObjectMap.tsx`:** after PR objectui#11335 lands, because its round 2 edits `getMapConfig`.
- **plugin-gantt `ObjectGantt.tsx`:** after objectui#10859 batch 6 (`domain:ui`, the gantt arm into the bag) and objectui#11168 slice 4 (`object-gantt`).
- **plugin-kanban `swimlaneField`:** it is half of one read, `swimlaneField || grouping.fields[0].field`. `grouping` is objectui#11216's (`domain:ui`, `pm:on-hold`, waiting on an objectstack release). Read #11216 before deciding `swimlaneField`, and ⛔ do not take `grouping`.
- **Everything else is free to go now.** If the serial items have not cleared when this card is dispatched, land the free packages and hand the rest back as a worklist.

## Out of scope ⛔

- The removal, the compile-fail pin, AGENTS.md §5 #0.1, and the probe-key flips: these are objectui#8347's.
- `ObjectKanban`'s `sort` ×2: rider objectui#8174.
- `ObjectKanban`'s `grouping`: objectui#11216.
- `plugin-timeline`'s `onItemClick`: the objectui#7804 handler family.

## Dedupe

Local grep over every objectui issue updated since 2026-09-01 (2,212 issues, open and closed, with bodies, read 2026-10-01T07:31Z):
- `showHeader`: 1 hit, objectui#9040 (closed; `RecordDetailsComponentProps`' top level, a different type).
- `swimlaneField` with `grouping`: 8 hits. The live one is objectui#11216 (open, `pm:on-hold`; `grouping`'s typed spec row), and this card defers to it. The other seven are closed.
- `EnvironmentListToolbar|InterfaceListPage` with `location`: 2 hits, objectui#9782 and #7547 (both closed; different defects).
- `commands/validate` with `title`: 0 hits.
- `isAnimationActive`: 1 hit, objectui#4044 (closed; dashboard `chartConfig` liveness, a different surface).

Dedupe words: BaseSchema index signature removal small sites · app-shell location literal BaseSchema · DetailView showHeader undeclared · cli validate title node union · ObjectGantt ObjectMap Record conversion TS2352 · isAnimationActive ObjectChartSchema test literal
